title: BrushCodex Bundle Manifest v1 (draft)
description: The manifest of a portable BrushCodex bundle (a ZIP named `.brushcodex.zip`). It lists the standard documents and permitted media the archive contains. Embeds the Common document envelope. The manifest itself lives at `manifest.json` inside the archive and does not list itself. Safe archive handling (path-traversal, archive-bomb, and unsupported-content rejection) is enforced by the reference reader, not the schema. DRAFT: not frozen; see specs/bundle/v1/README.md.

entry.description: One file in the archive. A `spec` marks it as a standard document (validated against that spec); its absence marks it as media.

path.description: Relative, forward-slash path within the archive. The reader additionally rejects '..' segments, absolute paths, and backslashes.

spec.description: Present for document entries; the file is validated against this specification.

mediaType.description: Content type. Documents use application/json (or a vendor +json type); media MUST be a permitted image type (see the reference reader).
